_comment: Ingredient-name resolution and slot grouping for the cookbook advisor.
A cooked dish reports its ingredients by FLAVOUR SOURCE, not by the item that went into the
pot: an Autumn Steak made from Raw Wild Pork says 'Boar'. IngredientResolver derives almost
all of those links from VSpec automatically (name match, 'Raw X'/'X Meat'/'Filet of X'
patterns, the meat-<animal> icon layer, and 'Block of Xwood' for smoking woods) - measured at
190 of 199 ingredient names on a mature database. Only the leftovers belong in 'aliases'.
Drop a file of the same shape next to the other nurgling json config to override this one.
_aliasNote: 'Bullfinch' is here because VSpec's Poultry category has a typo: the entry whose icon layer is
gfx/invobjs/meat-bullfinch is named 'Mammoth Meat'. Without this override the automatic
meat-token rule resolves Bullfinch to Mammoth Meat. Fixing VSpec itself would also fix it, but
that map is shared with the crafting bots, so the narrower fix lives here.
